# PECPool API TypeScript / Node.js Example

> Official Node.js 22+ TypeScript reference for securely calling the read-only PECPool API v1 with typed HMAC-SHA256 authentication.

Canonical project identity
- Repository: https://github.com/PECPool/pecpool-api-typescript-example
- Official website: https://pecpool.com/
- API base: https://api.pecpool.com
- API documentation: https://api.pecpool.com/index.html
- Canonical OpenAPI: https://api.pecpool.com/pecpoolapi/v1/pecpoolapi.json
- Language: TypeScript 7
- Runtime: server-side Node.js 22+
- Module format: ESM
- License: MIT for the repository example code
- Last public-contract verification: 2026-08-25

Scope
- Server-side and CLI connection example.
- Public read-only API only.
- No browser SDK, PECPool backend source, database schema, infrastructure detail, write operation, credential, or real customer data.

Authentication
- Required headers: X-PECPool-Key, X-PECPool-Timestamp, X-PECPool-Nonce, X-PECPool-Signature.
- Canonical string: METHOD\nPATH\nQUERY_STRING\nTIMESTAMP\nNONCE\nBODY_SHA256.
- METHOD is uppercase.
- PATH is the final encoded path without scheme or hostname.
- QUERY_STRING exactly matches the URL query without the leading question mark, including order and encoding.
- TIMESTAMP is Unix UTC seconds.
- NONCE is unique, 8–128 characters; this project uses 32 lowercase hex characters.
- Current GET body hash: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855.
- Signature: lowercase hexadecimal HMAC-SHA256 using the API Secret as key.
- The Secret is never transmitted.

Public endpoints
- GET /v1/ping
- GET /v1/farm
- GET /v1/monitor
- GET /v1/accounts
- GET /v1/accounts/{account}/summary
- GET /v1/accounts/{account}/monitor
- GET /v1/accounts/{account}/workers
- GET /v1/accounts/{account}/miners
- GET /v1/accounts/{account}/earnings
- GET /v1/accounts/{account}/payouts
- GET /v1/accounts/{account}/charts/hashrate
- GET /v1/accounts/{account}/workers/{worker}/charts/hashrate
- GET /v1/accounts/{account}/miners/{minerKey}/charts/hashrate
- GET /v1/snapshot

Rate limit
- One request every 10 seconds per Farm Key.
- HTTP 429 provides a retry delay.
- A retry must use a new timestamp, nonce, canonical request, and signature.
- The example does not retry automatically.

Primary files
- PECPoolApiClient.ts: typed endpoints and built-in fetch transport.
- PECPoolSigner.ts: RFC 3986 encoding and HMAC authentication.
- PECPoolApiError.ts: safe structured errors.
- PECPoolTypes.ts: optional public OpenAPI response types.
- index.ts: public exports.
- example.ts: one-request-per-run CLI.
- tests.ts: deterministic mocked tests with no live API calls.
- signing-test-vector.json: synthetic cross-language HMAC fixture.
- README.md and API.md: human integration documentation.
- AGENTS.md: coding-agent maintenance constraints.

Commands
- npm ci
- npm run cli -- help
- npm run cli -- ping
- npm run cli -- snapshot
- npm run cli -- account-summary ACCOUNT
- npm run build
- npm run typecheck
- npm test
- npm run check

Security invariants
- Never bundle credentials into browser or mobile code.
- Never place credentials in CLI arguments.
- Never log authentication material or private PECPool data.
- Keep TLS verification enabled and redirects rejected.
- Build the ordered query once; sign and send the identical encoded bytes.
- Encode each path segment exactly once.
- Use only documented endpoints and public response fields.
- Keep tests synthetic, mocked, and offline.

For current field definitions and limits, consult the canonical OpenAPI document instead of guessing.
